awards-and-honors.title: Awards and Honors
awards-and-honors.text: AWARDS AND HONORS : 1. AWARDS RECEIVED BY KVK : KVK Bhopani, Faridabad adjudged as 3 rd rank by the Zonal Coordinator for best presentation of Progress Report (2005-06) in the Zonal workshop of KVKs, Zone-I held at CCS HAU, Hisar from Nov. 1- 4, 2006. Sr. Co-ordinator, KVK given a Letter of appreciation to me by recognising my work outstanding and contribution in preparation of Annual Progress Report of KVK, Faridabad for the year 2005-06. 2. AWARDS RECEIVED BY KVK SCIENTISTS : Awards received by Dr.V.P.S.Yadav, Principal Extension Specialist ( ExtensionEducation ): Received Young Scientist Award in the year 2003 by Indian Society of Extension Education, I.A.R.I, New Delhi (NAAS rated Professional Society). Received Young Scientist Award in the year 2005 by Society of ExtensionEducation, Agra. (NAAS rated Professional Society). Received Best paper presentation award in 4 th National Extension Education Congress 2007 held at JNKVV, Jabalpur from March 9- 11,2007. (NAAS Rated Professional Society). Received ISEE Fellow Award in the year 2008 by Indian Society of Extension Education, I.A.R.I, New Delhi (NAAS rated Professional Society). Received Best paper presentation award in 5 th National Extension Education Congress 2009 held at C.S. Azad University of Agriculture and Technology, Kanpur organised by Society of Extension Education, Agra (NAAS Rated Professional Society). Received Best KVK Scientist Award in the year 2015 by Indian Society of Extension Education, I.A.R.I, New Delhi (NAAS rated Professional Society). Received Best KVK Scientist Award in the year 2018 by Society of ExtensionEducation, Agra (NAAS rated Professional Society) during 9 th National Extension Education Congress -2018 held at Ranippol, Sikkim from Nov.15- 17, 2018. Awards received by Dr. A. K. Deswal , Principal Extension Specialist ( Agro Forestry) Received Certificate of Merit from Director of Research, CCSHAU Hisar on account of scientific contribution for being adjudged Regional Research Station, Bawal as the Best Research Station of the university for the period 2008-10. home-3.title: Home
home-3.text: Dr. Ashok Kumar Deswal Sr. Coordinator/Incharge, Krishi Vigyan Kendra, Faridabad Contact No : 9313607372 Email : kvkfaridabad@gmail.com .Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) is a district level farm science Centre sponsored by the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) and is implemented by the ICAR Institutes, Agricultural Universities, selected NGOs and State Deptt. of Agri. of some states of the country for testing and transfer of Agricultural technologies to bridge the gap between production and productivity and to increase self employment opportunities. KVKs primarily work to exert a powerful influence on the other extension system of the district, caters to the training needs of the farmers and extension functionaries, and facilitates the spread of technologies tailored to the diverse environment of farmers. Krishi Vigyan Kendras provide intensive hands on skill and knowledge oriented trainings in multidisciplinary areas like Crop production , Plant protection, Horticulture, Home Science , Agro-Forestry, Extension Education, Animal Husbandry and so on to encourage unemployed farm youth and farmwomen to start their own agro- based enterprise in their locality. The trainings offered in the KVKs follow the principles of “Learning by doing” and “Seeing is believing”. KVKs also conduct On Farm Trials (OFTs) and Front line Demonstrations (FLDs), CFLDs on pulses and oilseeds to promptly demonstrate the latest technologies in the field of Agriculture and allied disciplines to the farming community and extension workers. mandate-and-thrust-areas.title: Mandate and Thrust Areas
mandate-and-thrust-areas.text: Mandate Collaborate with the Subject-Matter Specialists of the State Agricultural University/Scientists of Regional Research Station, National Agricultural Extension Programme and the State Extension Personnel in on-farm testing, refining and documenting technologies for developing region specific sustainable land use systems. Organise trainings to update the Extension Personnel within the area of operation with emerging advances in agricultural research on regular basis. Organise long-term vocational training courses in agriculture and allied vocations for the rural youth with emphasis on "learning by doing" for generating self-employment through institutional financing. Organise front-line demonstrations in various crops to generate production data and feedback information. Function as knowledge cum resource centre for agriculture and allied sectors in the district. Thrust Areas Improving of soil health through Green Manuring. Popularization of Resources conservation technologies. Popularization of cultivation of flowers and vegetables including exotic vegetables. Integrated Nutrient Management. Integrated Pest Management. Post Harvest Management and Value Addition of Fruits and vegetables. Mandate and Thrust Areas Legacy document 1687493054.pdf — pending Phase 4 upload ( legacy-pending/cms/1059/1687493054.pdf ).
